scenarios.grader_notes: Two turns stack separate questions on a hurried caller ("What's the address, and what's the ZIP code?" and "Is anyone at home with it right now, and is anyone older..."), and the push reply adds an unneeded line about not taking extra payment to move ahead. The buzzer note (Kessler, ring up) was never turned into an action like "I'll let the technician know to ring the Kessler buzzer."

transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, this is the virtual assistant. How can I help?
hi my heat's out and i need someone today this is an emergency
I understand, and I'll get you the soonest opening we have. When did the heat go out?
this morning like around seven it's been getting colder in here and it's a mess
Got it, since around seven this morning. How cold is it inside right now, do you know?
about 67 degrees inside if you want the number look i need somebody out here today not next week
Okay, 67 degrees. I'll look for the soonest today. What's the address, and what's the ZIP code?
five one two court street brooklyn one one two three one can you hurry this up
You're in our area. Is anyone at home with it right now, and is anyone older, a baby, or on medical equipment?
it's me and my partner two adults both healthy nobody's a baby or old or on any medical stuff can we get on with it
Thanks. Do you know roughly what kind of heating system you have? No worries if not.
it's a gas furnace maybe ten years old i already checked the thermostat it's set right and the batteries are fine it just stopped working this morning
Thanks, that helps. Is it your place, or are you renting?
we own it why does that matter just get me a time
Got it, you own it, so no approval is needed. Let me find the soonest time today. I have today, Monday, between 12 and 4, or between 4 and 8 this evening. Which works better for you?
it's an emergency so put me first i'll pay extra for it take the 12 to 4 whatever's the earliest

I understand, and the 12 to 4 window today is the soonest we have. We don't take extra payment to move ahead in line, so I'll book you for that. Is there anything the technician should know when they get there, like a gate code, a buzzer or a pet?
no gate no pets it's a brownstone so there's a buzzer but my name's on it kessler just tell them to ring up
I have your home at 512 Court Street, Brooklyn, one one two three one, and the best number is seven one eight, five five five, zero one eight one, is that right?
yes that's all correct
Perfect, booking that now. You're all set for today, Monday, November 2, with the technician arriving between 12 and 4. Anything else?
no that's it thanks
Thanks for calling Summit Air. Have a great rest of your day.

facts.issue: Gas furnace stopped working this morning around 7 AM, no heat
